lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regularly spaced high-luminance circular clusters arranged in distinct horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank, originating posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of spots, creating a faint rectilinear grid pattern along the mid-body.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear ridges visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity (dorsal) to low-intensity (ventral) shadows.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, elongated low-luminance object (likely a remora) trailing beneath the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
